Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 14
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical logical error in Step 14 by misinterpreting the ISO 8601 UTC timestamp (`+1975-08-08T00:00:00Z`) found in the Wikipedia metadata (Wikidata) as requiring conversion to the subject's local timezone (America/New_York) to determine the "real-world" birth date. The Planner incorrectly applied Daylight Saving Time logic, converting the UTC date to August 7, 1975, and asserted this as the authoritative answer, overriding the explicit "August 8, 1975" stated in the human-readable Wikipedia text and corroborated by multiple other search results. This is a fundamental error because birth dates are universally recorded and cited in the local date of the event, not converted from a database's internal UTC storage format.
